rule billing_need v1
description "Whether billing bills an order, waits, or skips it, from the order's state as ordering publishes it. Written for the example"

import proto "../../proto/shop/v1/order.proto" OrderStatus -> order_status
enum order_status = received | paid | shipped | cancelled
enum handling = wait | bill | skip

inputs
  status : order_status

outputs
  handling : handling

table decide
policy unique
| status    | -> handling |
| received  | wait        |
| paid      | bill        |
| shipped   | bill        |
| cancelled | skip        |

rule order_state v1
description "Where an online order goes on a payment, a shipment, a delivery or a request to cancel it, and how much is refunded. The caller keeps the state; the rule decides one event at a time. Written for the example"

enum state = received | paid | shipped | delivered | cancelled
enum event = pay | ship | deliver | cancel

inputs
  state       : state
  event       : event
  amount_paid : money[JPY, incl_tax]  range >=0JPY <=1000000JPY

outputs
  next_state : state
  refund     : money[JPY, incl_tax]  round down(1JPY)
  accepted   : bool

table step
policy unique
| state     | event             | -> next_state | refund      | accepted |
| received  | pay               | paid          | 0JPY        | true     |
| received  | cancel            | cancelled     | 0JPY        | true     |
| received  | ship, deliver     | state         | 0JPY        | false    |
| paid      | ship              | shipped       | 0JPY        | true     |
| paid      | cancel            | cancelled     | amount_paid | true     |
| paid      | pay, deliver      | state         | 0JPY        | false    |
| shipped   | deliver           | delivered     | 0JPY        | true     |
| shipped   | pay, ship, cancel | state         | 0JPY        | false    |  # a cancel after the shipment goes through a return
| delivered | -                 | state         | 0JPY        | false    |
| cancelled | -                 | state         | 0JPY        | false    |  # a payment that comes after a cancel does not bring the order back

machine order over step
  carry   state -> next_state
  held    amount_paid
  initial received
  final   delivered, cancelled
  never   shipped after cancelled
  once    refund >0JPY

scenario delivered
| event   | amount_paid | -> next_state | refund | accepted |
| pay     | 3000JPY     | paid          | 0JPY   | true     |
| ship    | 3000JPY     | shipped       | 0JPY   | true     |
| deliver | 3000JPY     | delivered     | 0JPY   | true     |

scenario late_pay
| event  | amount_paid | -> next_state | refund  | accepted |
| pay    | 3000JPY     | paid          | 0JPY    | true     |
| cancel | 3000JPY     | cancelled     | 3000JPY | true     |
| pay    | 3000JPY     | cancelled     | 0JPY    | false    |

examples
| state    | event  | amount_paid | -> next_state | refund | accepted |
| received | cancel | 0JPY        | cancelled     | 0JPY   | true     |
| shipped  | cancel | 3000JPY     | shipped       | 0JPY   | false    |

rule urgency v1
description "Whether an order goes out in a hurry, and by which carrier: a member's always does, and anyone else's from 30,000 yen. Written for the example"

enum carrier = standard | next_day

inputs
  member : bool
  amount : money[JPY, incl_tax]  range >=0JPY <=1000000JPY

outputs
  urgent  : bool
  carrier : carrier

table decide
policy unique
| member | amount     | -> urgent | carrier  |
| true   | -          | true      | next_day |
| false  | >=30000JPY | true      | next_day |
| false  | <30000JPY  | false     | standard |

examples
| member | amount   | -> urgent | carrier  |
| true   | 1000JPY  | true      | next_day |
| false  | 5000JPY  | false     | standard |
| false  | 30000JPY | true      | next_day |

dates net30 v1
description "Net 30: an invoice is due 30 days after it is sent, on the next day the office is open when that day is closed. The claims are this example's own"
use calendar "shop_days.cal"

inputs
  invoice_date : date  range >=2026-01-01 <=2027-11-30

date due = invoice_date
  + 30 days             # "Net 30": due 30 days after the invoice date
  roll following        # on the next business day when that day is closed

claims
  due_on_a_business_day   : due is open
  at_least_30_days        : due >= invoice_date + 30 days
  later_invoice_later_due : due is monotonic

examples
| invoice_date | -> due     |
| 2026-03-02   | 2026-04-01 |
| 2026-11-25   | 2026-12-28 |

# Stock held for an order: within 30 minutes it ships or is cancelled.
book inventory v1
description "Stock per SKU. A delivery adds to it, an order holds what it takes for 30 minutes, shipping posts the hold, cancelling voids it, and a return puts the goods back on the shelves"

unit pcs

account stock(sku: string) : pcs
  description "what is on the shelves"
  at least 0 refused as out_of_stock
account suppliers : pcs outside
account customers : pcs outside

transfer receive(delivery: string, sku: string, qty: pcs)
  key delivery, sku
  move qty from suppliers to stock(sku)

transfer reserve(order: string, sku: string, qty: pcs)
  description "posted when the order ships, voided when it is cancelled"
  key order, sku
  pending expires after 30 minutes
  move qty from stock(sku) to customers

transfer take_back(return_id: string, sku: string, qty: pcs)
  description "what a customer sent back, on the shelves again"
  key return_id, sku
  move qty from customers to stock(sku)

workflow ship_order v1
description "For an order in the warehouse's system, ask for the payment, have it shipped, and wait for word of the delivery. The warehouse's system keeps the order's state, which moves as rulec's rule order_state says. Written for Temporal: the warehouse's calls are activities dandori writes, and the notice is an activity you write; the carrier's system tells the workflow of the order about the delivery, by the order's id (an event); and an order the shop cancels on the way is cancelled at the warehouse too (on cancel). The loop over the reminders goes on in a new run when its history grows long"

use rule order_state from "rules/order_state.rule"
use rule urgency from "rules/urgency.rule"

record Order
  id     : string
  state  : order_state.state
  amount : money[JPY, incl_tax]  range >=0 <=1000000
  member : bool

record Receipt
  id : string

inputs
  order_id : string

outputs
  carrier : urgency.carrier

task get_order(id: string, expand: string) -> Order
  http GET "https://warehouse.example.com/v1/orders/{id}"
  observes
  idempotent
  errors busy = 429
  retry 3 times every 1 second on busy

task request_shipment(id: string, carrier: urgency.carrier) -> Order
  http POST "https://warehouse.example.com/v1/orders/{id}/shipments"
  sends ship
  errors conflict = 409
  refused as conflict
  key

task request_cancel(id: string) -> Order
  http POST "https://warehouse.example.com/v1/orders/{id}/cancellations"
  sends cancel
  errors conflict = 409
  refused as conflict
  key

# The shop's own notice service, called from code you write.
task notify(order_id: string, text: string) -> Receipt
  errors no_recipient
  key
  retry 2 times every 5 seconds

# The carrier's system sends the order as the warehouse has it now to the workflow of the
# order when the carrier reports the delivery.
task delivered() -> Order
  event
  observes
  timeout 7 days

case order : Order follows order_state.order
  external pay, deliver, cancel
  refused when accepted = false

flow
  order <- get_order(id: order_id, expand: "items")
  repeat at most 3 times
    match order.state
      received =>
        let r = notify(order_id: order.id, text: "We are waiting for your payment")
          on no_recipient => fail NoContact leaving order
        wait 1 day
        order <- get_order(id: order.id, expand: "items")
      paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled => break
  match order.state
    received =>
      order <- request_cancel(id: order.id)
        on conflict => pass
      fail NotPaid "No payment came in three days"
    cancelled => fail Canceled "The order was canceled"
    shipped, delivered => fail AlreadyShipped "The order has shipped already" leaving order
    paid => pass
  let decision = urgency(member: order.member, amount: order.amount)
  order <- request_shipment(id: order.id, carrier: decision.carrier)
    on conflict => fail Canceled "The order was canceled before it shipped"
  match decision.urgent
    true => let n = notify(order_id: order.id, text: "Shipped by next-day delivery")
    false => pass
  order <- delivered()
    on timeout => fail DeliveryLate "No word of the delivery in seven days" leaving order
  match order.state
    delivered => succeed carrier = decision.carrier
    shipped => fail DeliveryLate "Still shipped after word of the delivery" leaving order

on failure
  fail Stopped "Stopped on the way; the order stays in the warehouse's system as it is" leaving order

# The shop cancels the order on the way: the workflow is cancelled, and the warehouse is asked to
# cancel the order too, unless it has gone out.
on cancel
  match order.state
    none => pass
    received, paid =>
      order <- request_cancel(id: order.id)
        on conflict => fail ShippedAlready "The warehouse refused to cancel order {order.id}; it may have shipped" leaving order
        on failure => fail CancelFailed "Could not cancel order {order.id} at the warehouse" leaving order
    shipped => fail ShippedAlready "Order {order.id} has shipped already" leaving order

rule 請求の要否(billing_need) v1
description "受注が公表する注文の状態から、請求するか、待つか、請求しないかを決める。書き下ろしの例"

import proto "../../proto/shop/v1/order.proto" OrderStatus -> 注文の状態
enum 注文の状態(order_status) = 受付(received) | 支払済(paid) | 出荷済(shipped) | 取消(cancelled)
enum 請求の扱い(handling) = 待つ(wait) | 請求する(bill) | 請求しない(skip)

inputs
  状態(status) : 注文の状態

outputs
  扱い(handling) : 請求の扱い

table 扱いの判定(decide)
policy unique
| 状態   | -> 扱い     |
| 受付   | 待つ        |
| 支払済 | 請求する    |
| 出荷済 | 請求する    |
| 取消   | 請求しない  |

rule 出荷の急ぎ(urgency) v1
description "注文を急ぎで出すかどうかと、使う便。会員はいつも急ぎ、それ以外は三万円以上なら急ぎ。書き下ろしの例"

enum 便(carrier) = 通常便(standard) | 翌日便(next_day)

inputs
  会員(member) : bool
  金額(amount) : money[円, incl_tax]  range >=0円 <=100万円

outputs
  急ぎ(urgent) : bool
  便(carrier)  : 便

table 急ぎの判定(decide)
policy unique
| 会員  | 金額      | -> 急ぎ | 便     |
| true  | -         | true    | 翌日便 |
| false | >=30000円 | true    | 翌日便 |
| false | <30000円  | false   | 通常便 |

examples
| 会員  | 金額    | -> 急ぎ | 便     |
| true  | 1000円  | true    | 翌日便 |
| false | 5000円  | false   | 通常便 |
| false | 30000円 | true    | 翌日便 |

rule 注文の状態(order_state) v1
description "通販の注文が、入金・出荷・配達・取消依頼のイベントでどの状態に移り、いくら返金するか。状態は呼び出す側が持ち、規則は一回のイベントだけを判定する。書き下ろしの例"

enum 状態(state) = 受付(received) | 入金済(paid) | 出荷済(shipped) | 配達済(delivered) | 取消(cancelled)
enum イベント(event) = 入金(pay) | 出荷(ship) | 配達(deliver) | 取消依頼(cancel)

inputs
  状態(state)     : 状態
  イベント(event) : イベント
  支払額(paid)    : money[円, incl_tax]  range >=0円 <=100万円

outputs
  次の状態(next_state) : 状態
  返金額(refund)       : money[円, incl_tax]  round down(1円)
  受理(accepted)       : bool

table 遷移(step)
policy unique
| 状態   | イベント             | -> 次の状態 | 返金額 | 受理  |
| 受付   | 入金                 | 入金済      | 0円    | true  |
| 受付   | 取消依頼             | 取消        | 0円    | true  |
| 受付   | 出荷, 配達           | 状態        | 0円    | false |
| 入金済 | 出荷                 | 出荷済      | 0円    | true  |
| 入金済 | 取消依頼             | 取消        | 支払額 | true  |
| 入金済 | 入金, 配達           | 状態        | 0円    | false |
| 出荷済 | 配達                 | 配達済      | 0円    | true  |
| 出荷済 | 入金, 出荷, 取消依頼 | 状態        | 0円    | false |  # 出荷のあとの取消は、返品の手続きで受ける
| 配達済 | -                    | 状態        | 0円    | false |
| 取消   | -                    | 状態        | 0円    | false |  # 取消のあとに届いた入金の通知では、注文を戻さない

machine 注文(order) over 遷移
  carry   状態 -> 次の状態
  held    支払額
  initial 受付
  final   配達済, 取消
  never   出荷済 after 取消
  once    返金額 >0円

scenario 配達まで(delivered)
| イベント | 支払額 | -> 次の状態 | 返金額 | 受理 |
| 入金     | 3000円 | 入金済      | 0円    | true |
| 出荷     | 3000円 | 出荷済      | 0円    | true |
| 配達     | 3000円 | 配達済      | 0円    | true |

scenario 取消のあとの入金(late_pay)
| イベント | 支払額 | -> 次の状態 | 返金額 | 受理  |
| 入金     | 3000円 | 入金済      | 0円    | true  |
| 取消依頼 | 3000円 | 取消        | 3000円 | true  |
| 入金     | 3000円 | 取消        | 0円    | false |

examples
| 状態   | イベント | 支払額 | -> 次の状態 | 返金額 | 受理  |
| 受付   | 取消依頼 | 0円    | 取消        | 0円    | true  |
| 出荷済 | 取消依頼 | 3000円 | 出荷済      | 0円    | false |

workflow 出荷 v1
description "倉庫のシステムにある注文について、入金を催促し、出荷させ、配達の知らせを待つ。注文の状態は倉庫のシステムが持ち、その移り方は rulec の規則「注文の状態」に従う。Temporal 向けの版：倉庫の呼び出しは dandori が生成するアクティビティで、お知らせは自分で書くアクティビティ。配達のことは、運送会社のシステムが注文の ID を宛先にして知らせる（event）。お店が途中で注文を取り消すと、倉庫でも取り消す（on cancel）。催促のループは、履歴が長くなると新しい実行に引き継ぐ"

use rule 注文の状態 from "rules/注文の状態.rule"
use rule 急ぎ from "rules/出荷の急ぎ.rule"

record 注文
  id   : string
  状態 : 注文の状態.状態
  金額 : money[円, incl_tax]  range >=0 <=1000000
  会員 : bool

record 受付
  id : string

inputs
  注文ID : string

outputs
  便 : 急ぎ.便

task 注文を見る(id: string, expand: string) -> 注文
  http GET "https://warehouse.example.com/v1/orders/{id}"
  observes
  idempotent
  errors 混雑 = 429
  retry 3 times every 1 second on 混雑

task 出荷を頼む(id: string, 便: 急ぎ.便) -> 注文
  http POST "https://warehouse.example.com/v1/orders/{id}/shipments"
  sends 出荷
  errors 断られた = 409
  refused as 断られた
  key

task 取消を頼む(id: string) -> 注文
  http POST "https://warehouse.example.com/v1/orders/{id}/cancellations"
  sends 取消依頼
  errors 断られた = 409
  refused as 断られた
  key

# お店の通知サービス。自分で書くコードから呼ぶ。
task 知らせる(注文ID: string, 本文: string) -> 受付
  errors 宛先なし
  key
  retry 2 times every 5 seconds

# 運送会社のシステムは、配達を報告したとき、倉庫にあるそのときの注文を、注文のワークフローに送る。
task 配達の知らせ() -> 注文
  event
  observes
  timeout 7 days

case 受注 : 注文 follows 注文の状態.注文
  external 入金, 配達, 取消依頼
  refused when 受理 = false

flow
  受注 <- 注文を見る(id: 注文ID, expand: "items")
  repeat at most 3 times
    match 受注.状態
      受付 =>
        let 催促の控え = 知らせる(注文ID: 受注.id, 本文: "お支払いをお待ちしています")
          on 宛先なし => fail 連絡先なし leaving 受注
        wait 1 day
        受注 <- 注文を見る(id: 受注.id, expand: "items")
      入金済, 出荷済, 配達済, 取消 => break
  match 受注.状態
    受付 =>
      受注 <- 取消を頼む(id: 受注.id)
        on 断られた => pass
      fail 未入金 "三日たっても入金がありませんでした"
    取消 => fail 取消済み "取り消された注文です"
    出荷済, 配達済 => fail 既に出荷 "もう出荷されています" leaving 受注
    入金済 => pass
  let 判定 = 急ぎ(会員: 受注.会員, 金額: 受注.金額)
  受注 <- 出荷を頼む(id: 受注.id, 便: 判定.便)
    on 断られた => fail 取消済み "出荷の前に取り消されました"
  match 判定.急ぎ
    true => let 出荷の控え = 知らせる(注文ID: 受注.id, 本文: "翌日便で出荷しました")
    false => pass
  受注 <- 配達の知らせ()
    on timeout => fail 配達の遅れ "七日たっても配達の知らせがありません" leaving 受注
  match 受注.状態
    配達済 => succeed 便 = 判定.便
    出荷済 => fail 配達の遅れ "配達の知らせのあとも出荷済のままです" leaving 受注

on failure
  fail 中断 "途中で止まりました。注文は倉庫のシステムにそのまま残ります" leaving 受注

# お店が途中で注文を取り消すと、ワークフローはキャンセルされ、まだ出荷していなければ倉庫にも取消を頼む。
on cancel
  match 受注.状態
    none => pass
    受付, 入金済 =>
      受注 <- 取消を頼む(id: 受注.id)
        on 断られた => fail 出荷後の取消 "倉庫が注文 {受注.id} の取消を断りました。出荷されたのかもしれません" leaving 受注
        on failure => fail 取消の失敗 "倉庫で注文 {受注.id} を取り消せませんでした" leaving 受注
    出荷済 => fail 出荷後の取消 "注文 {受注.id} はもう出荷されています" leaving 受注
